invariants.statement: Only the seed startup-authority readiness owner captures and closes the formation-release generation; the generic publications owner stores that exact contract, while bootstrap, joiners, and rebalancer only validate or consume it.

The first satisfied observation captures the boot incarnation of each adopted current primary connection; node id alone, boot incarnation zero, or a high-water not bound to the adopted socket is non-authorizing.
A distinct joiner process receives the same seed-owned generation through the durable publication row and cannot locally mint, promote, or rotate formation-release authority.

First satisfaction captures a non-authorizing intent. Release becomes true only after the boot-disjoint publication write is read back through the canonical grammar, acknowledged by the interaction owner, and the readiness lane is rearmed.
Publication has exactly one in-flight write and one latest desired value; observations coalesce, shutdown discards pending desire, and no timer or unbounded promise tail owns progress.

The durable key and generation bind the seed authority node and positive current-primary boot incarnation, so an in-flight writer from an earlier seed boot cannot overwrite or authorize the current seed boot.
A restarted seed rehydrates its compatible active generation from the canonical publication row before observing new state; a changed peer boot, stale epoch, or malformed row cannot be restored.
A compatible priority-spread reopening cannot withdraw release before every captured JOINING incarnation publishes a current READY lease.
Missing membership, disconnect, boot-incarnation change, incompatible publication identity, substantive safety denial, or malformed authority revokes release fail closed.

A generation that completes admits the capture of its successor for the pre-ready JOINING members of the canonical set while the authority stays retainable against the completed generation (same fence, non-regressed epoch, cohort still canonical, exactly the priority-not-spread reopen); the admission is one typed variant closed by the successor capture, by any revocation, and by the first incompatible or absent authority observation, so a late joiner never falls to the raw spread predicate merely because the prior generation completed after the reopen was observed (GCP run 2026-08-30T10-05-10).

rules.reason: Regressed publication epoch or changed incarnation fence cannot inherit release authority.

The first whole-plane satisfaction event captures the seed and peer current-primary boot incarnations as a non-authorizing desired generation. The bounded publication coordinator persists it before recovery activity can close.
Only exact canonical readback for the current seed boot acknowledges the captured generation; acknowledgement rearms the existing readiness owner, which then projects release authority.
Write failure, delayed storage, or shutdown cannot turn process-local capture into release authority.
A provisional node-id cohort cannot later inherit release authority; durable node-row confirmation may confirm an already captured positive connection identity but cannot create it retroactively.
The joiner validates the seed publication against current authority, durable rows, and current process identity; its local formation owner remains idle.
A joiner cannot substitute its local view when the seed-owned durable contract is absent, stale, malformed, or bound to another incarnation.
Recovery resumes the exact seed-owned generation and reevaluates its captured cohort; it does not wait for a second globally satisfied observation or mint a replacement owner.
Spread is explicitly non-monotone until the captured cohort publishes READY; the retained owner remains cure and join-release authority.
READY publication is a whole captured-cohort closure, not a first-node or majority threshold.
Every exact captured incarnation has crossed the existing stable window and owns a fresh READY lease.

The completed generation's authority evidence (READY + spread satisfied when it was minted, still fenced by the retention predicate through the compatible reopen) is the minting evidence for its successor: the next evaluation captures the pre-ready JOINING cohort as a non-authorizing desired generation exactly as the READY path does, so the contract exists before late joiners reach the barrier; a substantive block, an incompatible identity, or a revocation closes the admission and capture returns to the READY gate.
The captured cohort cannot silently shrink while its process authority is unresolved.
A READY lease from one boot cannot close another boot's captured obligation.
Only the exact priority-not-spread reopening is retainable; admission, writability, eligibility, and evidence failures remain safety blocks.
Absent a complete first-satisfaction witness with a valid JOINING cohort, no release generation is minted.
